## Purpose

Defines the methods every Go enum MUST implement, the optional helpers that are recommended, and the domain-specific patterns that may be added on top. Every variant in the codebase conforms to this contract.

---

## Quick Reference — Mandatory Methods

| # | Method | Purpose |
|---|--------|---------|
| 1 | `String() string` | Serialization label |
| 2 | `Label() string` | Delegates to `String()` |
| 3 | `Is{Value}() bool` | Per-variant type check |
| 4 | `All() []Variant` | All valid variants |
| 5 | `ByIndex(i int) Variant` | Index → variant lookup |
| 6 | `Parse(s string) apperror.Result[Variant]` | String → variant |
| 7 | `IsValid() bool` | Validity check |
| 8 | `IsOther(other Variant) bool` | Generic inverse check |
| 9 | `IsAnyOf(others ...Variant) bool` | Multi-match check |
| 10 | `MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)` | JSON serialization |
| 11 | `UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error` | JSON deserialization |
